_fill.notes: ComfyUI API-format workflow for the COMPILE/EDIT pass (animation-cheats.plan.md): img2img over a mechanical composite, pose-pinned by the OpenPose ControlNet (rig-emitted skeleton), identity-pinned by IP-Adapter (character sheet / source render). Requires the ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus node pack (fetched by install-local-imagegen.sh; restart ComfyUI after first install). Fill by STRING REPLACEMENT like comfyui-workflow.template.json: numeric slots are quoted placeholders — replace INCLUDING the quotes. All image slots are filenames previously uploaded via POST /upload/image. For a whole-image compile pass upload an all-white mask; for a sub-cel edit upload a white-rect-on-black mask over the declared region.

slots.{{BASE_IMAGE}}: the mechanical composite (raw parts assembly) or held cel to edit
slots.{{POSE_IMAGE}}: the pose conditioning PNG — rig-emitted OpenPose skeleton (openpose.js) for the openpose ControlNet, or a rig-render edge map for scribble (profile shots: openpose is near-degenerate in pure profile, scribble on the mannequin edges carries pose + scale better)
slots.{{ID_IMAGE}}: identity reference — bound character sheet or the bank's source render
slots.{{MASK_IMAGE}}: white = repaint, black = keep. All-white for a full compile pass
slots.\"{{CN_STRENGTH}}\": openpose ControlNet strength (number; start ~0.8 — pose is declared geometry, pin it hard)
slots.\"{{DENOISE}}\": img2img denoise (number; the compile window — sweep 0.25/0.4/0.55 per P0)
slots.\"{{SEED}}\": render-event seed (number) — record with the bind; recipes stay timeless
